Question 1 [3 marks]: Outline the main features of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Provides accurate information about the main features of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79
2 marks: Provides some information about the main features of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79
1 marks: Makes a general statement(s) about a feature of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The eruption of Mount Vesuvius was preceded by earth tremors in the weeks and months prior. It began with a violent explosion, releasing a massive column of ash and pumice into the sky. The eruption released clouds of toxic gases, with volcanic material reaching heights of 33 kilometres.
